import RNA
target = '.....((((.(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).)))).....'
n=119
stack=[]
pairs=[-1]*n
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs[i]=j; pairs[j]=i

# Build seed: GC clamps at each stem close, A in loops, GU at very short stems to balance
# Outer stem: 5-113,6-112,7-111,8-110 -> GCGC/CGCG
# 4 hairpin modules, each: stem1 (i..i+2 pairs e.g. 14-21,15-20) + loop of 4 + stem2 (22-29,23-28) + loop 4
# Use GC at closing pairs of each hairpin, AU/GU alternation inside

# unpaired positions are '.': 0-4, 9, 13,16-19, 24-27, 30, 34, 38,41-44,49-52, 55, 59, 63,66-69,74-77,80, 84, 88,91-94,99-102,105, 109, 114-118

# Let me just construct: G/C at all pairs, A everywhere unpaired, then tune.
s=list('A'*n)
for i in range(n):
    if pairs[i]!=-1 and i<pairs[i]:
        j=pairs[i]
        s[i]='G'; s[j]='C'
seq=''.join(s)
fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq); ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
print('allGC ss:', ss)
print('dist:', sum(1 for a,b in zip(ss,target) if a!=b))

# Try: make loop regions GAAA tetraloops where there's a 4-loop
# Hairpin loops: positions 16-19 (closed by 15-20), 24-27 (closed 23-28), etc.
# Let me identify 4-nt hairpin loops: unpaired run of 4 between a close-pair
# Closing pair (i,j) where i+1..j-1 all unpaired and length 4
loops=[]
for i in range(n):
    if pairs[i]!=-1 and i<pairs[i]:
        j=pairs[i]
        run=[k for k in range(i+1,j) if pairs[k]==-1]
        if len(run)==j-i-1 and len(run)==4:
            loops.append((i,j,run))
print('4-loops:', loops)
EOF
